title: Concept: NuGet package declared with a version range
description: packages.config declares a package version written as a range, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The restore resolves whatever satisfies the range on that day, so two restores of the same file can bring different code.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through packages.config (nuget).
risk: The restore resolves whatever satisfies the range on that day, so two restores of the same file can bring different code.
